hunks.baseline: The bigger problem was that Jin Taekyung was not simply a man with exceptional toughness.

hunks.baseline: “……It would have been difficult.”

hunks.baseline: “I believe I told you to speak without holding anything back.”

hunks.baseline: A tiny ripple appeared in Go Jun’s previously unwavering eyes. The words that had come from Lee Jungryong were that shocking.

hunks.baseline: Go Jun muttered like a groan,
hunks.sol: Go Jun muttered as if groaning.

hunks.baseline: “Top secret? That’s a meaningless phrase. As long as someone knows something, it can never be a perfect secret.”

hunks.baseline: “Could Team Leader Choi have done it?”

hunks.baseline: “That boy Minwoo never learned a mana cultivation method. Neither did Kim Hwajong, who stayed by his side since childhood.”

hunks.baseline: “Isn’t it something no one knows about? If the Guild Master…”
hunks.sol: “But no one can know that for certain. If the Guild Master…”

hunks.baseline: Go Jun could not finish his sentence. He froze where he sat.
hunks.sol: Go Jun’s words died in his throat. He froze.

hunks.baseline: The moment he met Lee Jungryong’s deeply sunken eyes, he realized that he had said something he should not have.
hunks.sol: The moment he met Lee Jungryong’s dark, sunken gaze, he realized he had said something he should not have.

hunks.baseline: “I believe I told you not to even open your mouth about my older brother.”
hunks.sol: “I believe I told you never to utter a word about my older brother.”

hunks.baseline: “I-I’m sorry. I misspoke…”

hunks.baseline: Go Jun’s voice trembled like a wounded bird.
hunks.sol: Go Jun’s voice quivered like a wounded bird.

hunks.baseline: “Forgiveness? These things happen in life.”
hunks.sol: “Forgive you? These things happen.”

hunks.sol: Even after carefully rising from his knees and returning to his seat, Go Jun could not look Lee Jungryong in the eye.

hunks.baseline: To Go Jun, Lee Jungryong was an object of both respect and fear.

hunks.baseline: Go Jun’s usually machine-like expression was now tinged with quiet fear.
hunks.sol: Faint fear now colored the face that was ordinarily as expressionless as a machine.

hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong turned toward the window. Beyond the spotless glass, the Han River stretched wide into the distance.

hunks.sol: *Do not take so much as a single step out from behind me.*
